frontier.hypothesis: Target's selection block is the SINGLE-call two-arm form, and the ONLY thing separating it from the banked 10/205 bucket is one failing precondition of the tools/gcc-2.7.2/jump.c:754-860 normalisation. Three predicates are still untried: B4 (jump.c:766-768 - the branch-target arm's value comes from MEMORY, so SET_SRC is neither REG, SUBREG nor CONSTANT_P), B8 (jump.c:794-812,831 - LABEL_NUSES of the else-label cannot be fully discharged by conditional jumps found walking backwards from the condjump, e.g. because a CALL_INSN breaks the walk at jump.c:812 or because a second entry to the else arm is FORWARD), and B9 (jump.c:832 - a CODE_LABEL sits between the last conditional jump and the then-arm's terminating jump).
frontier.mechanism: Blocking the normalisation is sufficient: the store-flag gate at jump.c:1178-1181 then never receives a CONST_INT because nothing moved `sound = 4` in front of the conditional jump, and its own precondition at jump.c:1065-1068 fails for a two-arm shape anyway. The surviving two-arm form is what reorg's steal_delay_list_from_target turns into target's `beqz v0,<join>` + delay-slot `li a0,4` + fallthrough `move a0,zero`, with the loaded byte free to sit in $v0.
frontier.next_probe: Spell and measure C shapes for each untried predicate, checking each against the .jump dump (tools/grinder/dump.ps1 func_800747D8) for the ABSENCE of a newly created `r = 4` insn immediately before the conditional jump (the s6 insn-622 signature) BEFORE crediting any score. For B9 the vehicle must be a compound condition whose two operands cannot be coalesced into one comparison - the adjacent-byte ORIF measured this session collapses to a single lhu, so pick operands in different words or of different widths. For B8, look for a spelling in which the else arm is entered from a second, FORWARD site. For B4, look for a spelling in which the branch-target arm's value is loaded rather than materialised.

frontier.hypothesis: The duplicated-call chassis is closable in principle - its arms merge 3 insns deep once the arm jump's own label is the if/else join - but every spelling that preserves that join also relocates the block, and the relocation costs +9 insns that target's own block order (selection block first, before case 1) forbids recovering.
frontier.mechanism: tools/gcc-2.7.2/jump.c:2403 find_cross_jump decides match depth from the insn physically preceding the jump's label; jump threading moves that label from the join to `confirm` whenever the join is immediately followed by an unconditional jump. Target's own selection block ends in a forward jump (j .L80074A20), so target's join is in exactly that threaded configuration - which is why target only gets the 1-insn own-label merge at the shared jal and therefore cannot be a duplicated call.
frontier.next_probe: Do NOT re-spend sessions on the duplicated-call family or on s6's suggested reordering of case 2's call; both are now measured or excluded. If a later session wants to revisit it, the only untried lever is a real (non-dead) statement between the if/else join and the `goto confirm;` that blocks the threading - and no such statement exists in target's asm, so it would have to come from a sanctioned duplicated-statement-into-arms grant with its own lever-exhaustion record, not from this chassis.

frontier.hypothesis: Hunk 9's jtbl_80015A0C table-offset residual closes once the hand-transcribed array is deleted from src/text1a_b_mid_rodata.c in the same change that lands func_800747D8's real switch as committed C, mirroring the already-executed func_8006B578/jtbl_80015988 precedent.
frontier.mechanism: GCC 2.7.2 emits a switch's ADDR_VEC into the .rodata of the TU containing the switch; with the hand array still present in text1a_b_mid_rodata.c the sandbox's isolated single-function build sees a placement/offset conflict (ours `lw v0,24(at)` vs target `lw v0,0(at)`) rather than the real target layout.
frontier.next_probe: At final-submission assembly time only (not a src/text1b.c-only session): delete the jtbl_80015A0C array from src/text1a_b_mid_rodata.c in the same commit as func_800747D8's C body, then re-measure with sandbox --disable all --diff.
